h: Brymo takes a swipe at Nigeria's 'Big 3', says they are not men
p: Singer Brymo has reportedly criticised Nigeria's biggest music stars, mocking what he called their reliance on their parents. He did not name anyone, but fans assumed he meant the so-called Big 3.
body: Nigerian singer Brymo has reportedly stirred debate online after taking a swipe at the country's biggest music stars, popularly known as the Big 3.

In a statement shared on social media, Brymo is said to have questioned the maturity and independence of top artistes, mocking the idea of a grown star relying on his parents to defend him in public or travel around with him, while still claiming to be the biggest artiste in Nigeria. He ended with the line that such a person is not a man.
Brymo did not mention anyone by name, but many social media users took his comments as aimed at Davido, Wizkid and Burna Boy, who are often grouped together as the Big 3.
Reactions were mixed, with some users agreeing with him and others suggesting he had a personal grudge.
more: Brymo did not name any artiste.
Fans believe he was referring to the Big 3.
